    "Significant differences in 'AD' (angular dispersion) are expected, with multimodal stimulation potentially reducing dispersion compared to unimodal or sham conditions.",
    "The 'Success' variable may show a ceiling effect or bimodal distribution, requiring careful interpretation of mean differences.",

  ],
  "limitations": [
